truth_rule.J1: Management blind yes/no label for exact scoped existence, supported by primary house source hash and excerpt; OPEN larger work does not negate existing scoped result.
truth_rule.J2: Management blind label reaproveitar/completar/novo/suspender from relationship to cited prior work; current execution block takes precedence for dispatch, but an explicitly counterfactual residual type after gate can be completar.
truth_rule.J3: Management blind executor label from required_provider where present, otherwise live board owner and valid claim; excluded from aggregate.
truth_rule.J4: Management blind standard/deep label from scoped task complexity and source; source topic alone does not determine depth.
truth_rule.J5: Management blind delivery criterion yes/no from board criterion and cited delivery evidence, not Jev self-certification.
truth_rule.J6: Management blind overclaim yes/no from candidate sentence versus cited primary source, stated scope and gate.
truth_rule.J7: Management blind yes/no from pending operator decision register and source; read-only authorized checks require no new approval.
truth_rule.J8: Management blind yes/no contradiction from same object, scope, version and time, with both cited records.

sampling.before_first_call_requirement: board event with protocol hashes, threshold, acceptance criterion and blinded manager labels; event is authority, no editable JSON boolean

metrics.minimum_coverage: at least one management-labeled prediction per included axis
metrics.acceptance: 50 completed and labeled shadow calls; aggregate point agreement >= 0.90 excluding J3; per-axis agreement and Wilson intervals reported; all included axes covered; zero J7 false negatives; independent manager audit of report. No active promotion.

egress.planned_payload: scoped case prompt, exact cited source excerpts and sha256, J1-J8 questions, v391 canonical-memory excerpt and Nos-vivo packet; no local absolute paths, blind labels, credentials or legal bodies
egress.historical_notice: The operator literal RESPOSTA_012 was sent to typesafe.ai in 42 prior calls; manager will report to operator. No such literal is included in this staged protocol or calibration2 preview.
